***Atlantic City America's Playground*** is the 18th major update for *Fallout 76*. It was released on March 26, 2024, alongside Season 16. It followed *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* and preceded *Skyline Valley*.

Along with several bug fixes and improvements, the following key changes were featured in this update:

Every time you rank up, you will earn 25 Tickets which can be redeemed for rewards on the pages you've unlocked. Just like with the Scoreboard, all you need to do to increase your rank is earn S.C.O.R.E. by completing challenges.

Atlantic City – America’s Playground also expands upon Fallout’s take on post-nuclear New Jersey, allowing players to explore the City at their leisure further or even take on new Side Quests. Meet with the local merchants and shop or even pass on the torch within The Family's inner circle!
